dialogue_templates.text: It's good to see you again. After what you did for us, my door is always open.
Few people in the ash keep their word. You proved yourself an exception.
For you? Take the goods at cost. We survive together or not at all.
State your business and be quick. I haven't forgotten how you turned your back on us.
You come asking for help now? When we needed you, you gave us silence.
The price is double for you. Consider it an uncollected debt surcharge.
I owe you one from last week. Tell me what you need, and we'll square the ledger.
My people remember who pulled us out of the rubble. Ask your favor.
Get out of my sight before I draw iron. You sold us out once; there won't be a second time.
My counter is closed to traitors. Take your tainted chits elsewhere.
Your restitution covers the loss. We aren't friends, but the slate is wiped clean.
Words are cheap in the wasteland, but your deeds made amends. Let's start over.
